response.message: That wall is as strong as it gets

notifications.title: A horde tore down your wall
notifications.body: Between (-2, 2) and (-3, 3).

notifications.title: Sosnovka is under attack
notifications.body: A horde of 12 is fighting your garrison of 2.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Sosnovka
notifications.body: The low south horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (3, 4)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2800 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The captives at (-7, 8) were taken away
notifications.body: The next horde from the south hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Spring has come
notifications.body: The thaw: the land wakes, and every front stirs alike.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-6, 9)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2450 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: The boatwrights at (-4, 8) gave up and left
notifications.body: The next horde from the south hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Winter has come
notifications.body: Snow on the fields: no grain at all, the stores must last. The Monsters of the North come twice as often.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (-7, 8)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 2100 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: The captives at (-6, 8) were taken away
notifications.body: The next horde from the south hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Autumn has come
notifications.body: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-4, 8)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (-6, 8)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: Done: Train defenders
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: Barracks level 1 in Sosnovka
notifications.body: Finished.

notifications.title: Done: Raise a building
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (1, 4).
